title: Clyde Tombaugh and Earth's small moons; gray motherships in orbit

tellings.quote: And he wrote he wrote an article, Tom Bar wrote an article saying that Earth had um some smaller moons orbiting at about 500 miles up.

plain: In the 1950s the astronomer Clyde Tombaugh is said to have written an article saying that Earth had some small extra moons orbiting about 500 miles up. A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants, brings this up without naming where he read it and ties it to the idea of gray motherships parked in orbit. If true, large craft would have been circling the planet and seen by a professional astronomer.
